test.heading: ### Python Testing
test.content:
Run all tests:
```bash
pytest -v
```

Run with coverage:
```bash
pytest --cov=. --cov-report=html --cov-report=term
```

Run specific test file:
```bash
pytest tests/test_specific.py -v
```

Run with markers:
```bash
pytest -m "not slow" -v
```

Skip integration tests:
```bash
pytest -m "not integration" -v
```

build.heading: ### Python Building
build.content:
Build package:
```bash
python -m build
```

Install in development mode:
```bash
pip install -e .
```

Install with dependencies:
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Check for dependency issues:
```bash
pip check
```

quality-gate.heading: ### Python Quality Gates
quality-gate.content:
Run all quality checks:
```bash
flake8 . && pytest -v && mypy .
```

Format check:
```bash
black --check .
```

Lint with pylint:
```bash
pylint **/*.py
```

Type checking:
```bash
mypy .
```
